expected.name: sRGB <-> OKYCT Bidirectional Round-Trip Accuracy
expected.details: Verifies single-variable 3rd-order Halley solver (dY/dL, d²Y/dL² with Newton-Raphson fallback) convergence across the full sRGB cube.

expected.name: Tone <-> CIE Y Analytical Bijection & Monotonicity
expected.details: Guarantees strictly monotonic mapping between perceptual Tone and physical luminance Y.

expected.name: 8-bit Hex Quantization Hue & Tone Budget
expected.details: Verifies 8-vertex perceptual JND quantization preserves OKLab hue and Tone within tight bounds.

expected.name: 360° Gamut Containment & Zero Hue Drift
expected.formula: C=0.38 under preserve-tone & cusp-compress: ΔHue & channel bounds
expected.details: Ensures out-of-gamut colors stay strictly inside [0, 1] RGB with negligible hue rotation.

expected.name: O(1) Dual WCAG 2.1 + APCA Contrast Inversion Guard
expected.formula: WCAG >= 4.5 & |APCA Lc| >= 60 for solved foreground tones
expected.details: Verifies closed-form WCAG 2.1 and analytical APCA inverse Tone solvers across [0, 100].

expected.warningMessage: Warning: after 3 composited layers, background Tone shifted by ΔT=+9.8, reducing contrast to WCAG 1.08:1 / APCA Lc 0.

expected.recommendation: Low protanopia separability (ΔE=0.0296, ΔT=3.27): separate Tone by >=12 or shift hue/iconography.
Low protanopia separability (ΔE=0.0376, ΔT=3.18): separate Tone by >=12 or shift hue/iconography.
Low deuteranopia separability (ΔE=0.0568, ΔT=5.71): separate Tone by >=12 or shift hue/iconography.
Low deuteranopia separability (ΔE=0.0159, ΔT=1.84): separate Tone by >=12 or shift hue/iconography.
Low tritanopia separability (ΔE=0.0191, ΔT=1.5): separate Tone by >=12 or shift hue/iconography.

spec.name: WRGB Tandem OLED (Desktop / TV)
spec.description: Models desktop/TV WRGB Tandem OLED panels where a dedicated high-efficiency white subpixel carries achromatic luminance, reducing RGB emitter stress on bright surfaces.
